Name: mp_freezetime
Description: 设置玩家在每回合开始时保持冻结的秒数，以及他们用于购买和计划的时间。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds players stay frozen at the start of each round, time they use to buy and plan.

Name: mp_roundtime
Description: 设置在没有炸弹或人质目标的地图上每回合持续多少分钟。
Description_EN: Sets how many minutes each round lasts on maps without a bomb or hostage objective.

Name: mp_warmup_end
Description: 热身期立即结束，比赛开始。
Description_EN: Ends the warmup period immediately and starts the match.

Name: mp_restartgame
Description: 在给定的秒数后重新开始比赛，重置分数、金钱和回合。
Description_EN: Restarts the match after the given number of seconds, resetting scores, money and rounds.

Name: sv_cheats
Description: 允许在服务器上执行作弊命令，例如 noclip、god 和练习工具。
Description_EN: Allows cheat commands on the server, such as noclip, god and practice tools.

Name: mp_buytime
Description: 设置回合开始后多少秒玩家仍然可以购买。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds after the round starts players can still buy.

Name: mp_startmoney
Description: 设置比赛开始和每个半场开始时每位玩家的初始金钱数额（美元）。
Description_EN: Sets how much money each player starts with at the beginning of a match and each half, in dollars.

Name: mp_maxmoney
Description: 设置玩家可以持有的最大金额（以美元为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum amount of money a player can hold, in dollars.

Name: mp_maxrounds
Description: 设置比赛结束前的最大回合数。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum number of rounds in a match before it ends.

Name: bot_kick
Description: 从服务器中踢出Bot：所有Bot、一个团队或按名称踢出单个Bot。
Description_EN: Kicks bots from the server: all of them, one team, or a single bot by name.

Name: sv_infinite_ammo
Description: 为玩家提供无限弹药，无需重新装弹或无限储备弹药。
Description_EN: Gives players unlimited ammo, either with no reloading or with unlimited reserve ammo.

Name: mp_buy_anywhere
Description: 让玩家可以在地图上的任何地方购买，而不仅仅是在他们的购买区域。
Description_EN: Lets players buy anywhere on the map instead of only in their buy zone.

Name: cl_crosshairsize
Description: 设置每条十字线的长度；数字越小，十字准线越短、越紧。
Description_EN: Sets the length of each crosshair line; smaller numbers give a shorter, tighter crosshair.

Name: viewmodel_fov
Description: 设置武器模型的视野，从 54 到 68；值越高表明枪越小且距离越远。
Description_EN: Sets the field of view of your weapon model, from 54 to 68; higher values show the gun smaller and further away.

Name: cl_showfps
Description: 在屏幕顶部显示 FPS 计数器；较高的值显示平滑的 FPS 或服务器计时。
Description_EN: Shows an FPS counter at the top of the screen; higher values show smoothed FPS or server timing.

Name: noclip
Description: 切换 noclip，让你飞过墙壁。
Description_EN: Toggles noclip, letting you fly through walls.

Name: mp_backup_restore_list_files
Description: 列出最近一轮的备份文件，最新的在前。
Description_EN: Lists recent round backup files, newest first.

Name: mp_backup_restore_load_file
Description: 从回合备份文件中恢复比赛：金钱、击杀数、得分和团队得分。
Description_EN: Restores a match from a round backup file: money, kills, scores and team scores.

Name: mp_backup_round_file
Description: 设置循环备份的文件名前缀，以便您在崩溃后恢复匹配。
Description_EN: Sets the file name prefix for round backups that let you restore a match after a crash.

Name: mp_c4timer
Description: 设置炸弹放置后需要多少秒才能爆炸。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds the bomb takes to explode after it is planted.

Name: mp_give_player_c4
Description: 切换恐怖分子是否在每回合开始时获得 C4。
Description_EN: Toggles whether a Terrorist gets the C4 at the start of each round.

Name: mp_halftime
Description: 切换球队在半场换边。
Description_EN: Toggles teams switching sides at halftime.

Name: mp_halftime_duration
Description: 设置中场休息持续多少秒。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds the halftime break lasts.

Name: mp_halftime_pausetimer
Description: 将比赛保留到半场，直到您将其设置回 0。
Description_EN: Holds the game in halftime until you set it back to 0.

Name: mp_ignore_round_win_conditions
Description: 当队伍被淘汰或目标完成时，停止回合结束。
Description_EN: Stops rounds from ending when a team is eliminated or an objective is completed.

Name: mp_join_grace_time
Description: 设置回合开始后多少秒，加入的玩家仍会在该回合中生成。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds after round start a joining player still spawns in that round.

Name: mp_match_can_clinch
Description: 一旦另一支球队无法追赶，切换一支球队是否可以提前获胜。
Description_EN: Toggles whether a team can win early once the other team can no longer catch up.

Name: mp_overtime_enable
Description: 当比赛以平局结束时切换加时赛。
Description_EN: Toggles overtime when a match ends in a tie.

Name: mp_overtime_maxrounds
Description: 设置每个加时赛持续多少轮。
Description_EN: Sets how many rounds each overtime lasts.

Name: mp_overtime_startmoney
Description: 设置每位球员在每个加时半场开始时获得的奖金（以美元为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the money every player gets at the start of each overtime half, in dollars.

Name: mp_pause_match
Description: 在下一个冻结时间开始时暂停比赛。
Description_EN: Pauses the match at the start of the next freeze time.

Name: mp_plant_c4_anywhere
Description: 让恐怖分子在地图上的任何地方放置炸弹，而不仅仅是在炸弹地点。
Description_EN: Lets Terrorists plant the bomb anywhere on the map, not only at bomb sites.

Name: mp_respawn_immunitytime
Description: 设置玩家重生后免疫伤害的秒数。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds players are immune to damage after respawning.

Name: mp_respawn_on_death_ct
Description: 使反恐精英在死亡后重生。
Description_EN: Makes Counter-Terrorists respawn after dying.

Name: mp_respawn_on_death_t
Description: 使恐怖分子死后重生。
Description_EN: Makes Terrorists respawn after dying.

Name: mp_round_restart_delay
Description: 设置一轮结束和下一回合开始之间的延迟（以秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the delay in seconds between the end of a round and the start of the next.

Name: mp_roundtime_defuse
Description: 设置在《Dust II》或《Mirage》等炸弹拆除地图上每回合持续多少分钟。
Description_EN: Sets how many minutes each round lasts on bomb defusal maps such as Dust II or Mirage.

Name: mp_roundtime_hostage
Description: 设置在 Office 或意大利等人质救援地图上每回合持续多少分钟。
Description_EN: Sets how many minutes each round lasts on hostage rescue maps such as Office or Italy.

Name: mp_team_timeout_max
Description: 设置每队每场比赛获得多少次战术暂停。
Description_EN: Sets how many tactical timeouts each team gets per match.

Name: mp_timelimit
Description: 为每张地图设置时间限制（以分钟为单位），之后比赛结束。
Description_EN: Sets a time limit in minutes for each map, after which the match ends.

Name: mp_unpause_match
Description: 恢复因 mp_pause_match 或超时而暂停的比赛。
Description_EN: Resumes a match paused with mp_pause_match or by a timeout.

Name: mp_warmup_online_enabled
Description: 切换在线比赛开始时是否启用热身阶段。
Description_EN: Toggles the warmup period at the start of an online match.

Name: mp_warmup_pausetimer
Description: 暂停热身倒计时，以便热身持续到您结束为止。
Description_EN: Pauses the warmup countdown so warmup lasts until you end it.

Name: mp_warmup_start
Description: 开始热身期，即使是在比赛中间。
Description_EN: Starts a warmup period, even in the middle of a match.

Name: mp_warmuptime
Description: 设置比赛开始前热身时间持续多少秒。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds the warmup period lasts before the match starts.

Name: cash_player_killed_enemy_default
Description: 设置玩家每次击杀所赚取的基础金钱（以美元为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the base money a player earns for each kill, in dollars.

Name: cash_player_killed_teammate
Description: 设置玩家杀死队友所获得的金钱，通常是负数。
Description_EN: Sets the money a player gets for killing a teammate, usually a negative amount.

Name: cash_team_elimination_bomb_map
Description: 设置团队通过消灭炸弹地图上的敌人而获胜所获得的金钱（以美元为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the money a team gets for winning by eliminating the enemy on a bomb map, in dollars.

Name: cash_team_loser_bonus
Description: 设置失败的球队在一轮后获得的基础资金（以美元为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the base money the losing team gets after a round, in dollars.

Name: cash_team_loser_bonus_consecutive_rounds
Description: 设置每次连续损失添加到损失奖金中的额外金额（以美元为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the extra money added to the loss bonus for each consecutive loss, in dollars.

Name: mp_afterroundmoney
Description: 除了正常奖励之外，每回合结束后还给每个玩家这么多钱（以美元计）。
Description_EN: Gives every player this much money after each round, in dollars, on top of normal rewards.

Name: mp_buy_allow_grenades
Description: 切换是否可以从购买菜单购买手榴弹。
Description_EN: Toggles whether grenades can be bought from the buy menu.

Name: mp_buy_allow_guns
Description: 设置可以购买哪些枪支类别，作为武器类型的位掩码。
Description_EN: Sets which gun categories can be bought, as a bitmask of weapon types.

Name: mp_defuser_allocation
Description: 控制 CT 是否在回合开始时获得免费的拆弹套件。
Description_EN: Controls whether CTs get a free defuse kit at round start.

Name: mp_free_armor
Description: 在生成时免费为玩家提供盔甲：仅凯夫拉纤维，或凯夫拉纤维和头盔。
Description_EN: Gives players armor for free at spawn: kevlar only, or kevlar and helmet.

Name: mp_max_armor
Description: 设置允许玩家购买的最好的盔甲。
Description_EN: Sets the best armor players are allowed to buy.

Name: mp_playercashawards
Description: 切换玩家通过自己的行动赚钱，例如击杀和放置炸弹。
Description_EN: Toggles players earning money for their own actions, such as kills and bomb plants.

Name: mp_teamcashawards
Description: 切换团队根据回合胜利、失败和目标赚钱。
Description_EN: Toggles teams earning money for round wins, losses and objectives.

Name: mp_weapons_allow_rifles
Description: 设置哪个团队可以购买步枪。
Description_EN: Sets which team can buy rifles.

Name: mp_weapons_allow_typecount
Description: 限制玩家每回合可以购买的每种类型武器的数量。
Description_EN: Limits how many weapons of each type a player can buy per round.

Name: mp_weapons_allow_zeus
Description: 限制玩家每回合可以购买的 Zeus x27 泰瑟枪数量。
Description_EN: Limits how many Zeus x27 tasers a player can buy per round.

Name: mp_autokick
Description: 切换踢闲置玩家和团队击杀或造成过多团队伤害的玩家。
Description_EN: Toggles kicking idle players and players who team kill or deal too much team damage.

Name: mp_autoteambalance
Description: 在回合之间切换自动团队平衡。
Description_EN: Toggles automatic team balancing between rounds.

Name: mp_forcecamera
Description: 限制死亡玩家可以观看的内容。
Description_EN: Restricts what dead players can spectate.

Name: mp_friendlyfire
Description: 切换玩家是否可以伤害自己的队友。
Description_EN: Toggles whether players can damage their own teammates.

Name: mp_humanteam
Description: 将人类玩家限制在一支队伍中，而将另一支队伍留给Bot。
Description_EN: Restricts human players to one team, leaving the other for bots.

Name: mp_limitteams
Description: 设置一支球队可以比另一支球队多拥有多少名球员。
Description_EN: Sets how many more players one team can have than the other.

Name: mp_playerid
Description: 控制玩家瞄准某人时看到的名字。
Description_EN: Controls whose names players see when they aim at someone.

Name: mp_randomspawn
Description: 在地图周围的随机点生成玩家，而不是在团队生成。
Description_EN: Spawns players at random points around the map instead of their team spawn.

Name: mp_scrambleteams
Description: 在两支球队之间随机洗牌并重新开始比赛。
Description_EN: Shuffles players randomly between the two teams and restarts the game.

Name: mp_solid_teammates
Default: 2 (Solid and you can stand on heads)
Description: 控制玩家是否与队友发生碰撞以及能否倒立。
Description_EN: Controls whether players collide with teammates and can stand on their heads.

Name: mp_spectators_max
Description: 设置可以加入观众队伍的玩家人数。
Description_EN: Sets how many players can join the spectator team.

Name: mp_swapteams
Description: 交换两队阵容并重新开始比赛。
Description_EN: Swaps the two teams' sides and restarts the game.

Name: mp_teammates_are_enemies
Description: 让队友算作敌人，这样每个人都可以射击每个人。
Description_EN: Makes teammates count as enemies so everyone can shoot everyone.

Name: mp_teamname_1
Description: 为第一支球队（以 CT 开头的球队）设置自定义名称。
Description_EN: Sets a custom name for the first team (the team that starts as CT).

Name: mp_teamname_2
Description: 为第二个团队（以 T 开头的团队）设置自定义名称。
Description_EN: Sets a custom name for the second team (the team that starts as T).

Name: sv_disable_radar
Description: 始终或仅在热身期间关闭所有玩家的雷达。
Description_EN: Turns off the radar for all players, always or only during warmup.

Name: sv_teamid_overhead
Description: 切换队友头顶上显示的团队标记。
Description_EN: Toggles the team marker shown above teammates' heads.

Name: bot_add
Description: 将Bot添加到服务器，可以选择其团队、难度和名称。
Description_EN: Adds a bot to the server, optionally choosing its team, difficulty and name.

Name: bot_add_ct
Description: 向反恐团队添加一个Bot。
Description_EN: Adds a bot to the Counter-Terrorist team.

Name: bot_add_t
Description: 向恐怖分子团队添加一个Bot。
Description_EN: Adds a bot to the Terrorist team.

Name: bot_all_weapons
Description: 让Bot再次使用每种武器。
Description_EN: Lets bots use every weapon again.

Name: bot_allow_grenades
Description: 切换Bot是否可以使用手榴弹。
Description_EN: Toggles whether bots can use grenades.

Name: bot_auto_vacate
Description: 让Bot自动离开，为加入的人类腾出空位。
Description_EN: Makes bots leave automatically to free a slot for a joining human.

Name: bot_chatter
Description: 控制Bot通过无线电和语音交谈的数量。
Description_EN: Controls how much bots talk over radio and voice.

Name: bot_crouch
Description: 使所有Bot蹲下。
Description_EN: Makes all bots crouch.

Name: bot_difficulty
Description: 设置加入游戏的Bot的技能水平。
Description_EN: Sets the skill level of bots that join the game.

Name: bot_dont_shoot
Description: 阻止Bot开火。
Description_EN: Stops bots from firing their weapons.

Name: bot_freeze
Description: 阻止Bot移动，同时它们仍然可以瞄准和射击。
Description_EN: Stops bots from moving while they can still aim and shoot.

Name: bot_join_after_player
Description: 让Bot等到人类加入后再进入游戏。
Description_EN: Makes bots wait until a human joins before they enter the game.

Name: bot_join_team
Description: 设置哪些团队Bot加入。
Description_EN: Sets which team bots join.

Name: bot_kill
Description: 立即杀死Bot：所有Bot、一个团队或单个Bot的名字。
Description_EN: Kills bots instantly: all of them, one team, or a single bot by name.

Name: bot_knives_only
Description: 限制Bot只能使用刀具。
Description_EN: Restricts bots to knives only.

Name: bot_mimic
Description: 让Bot复制您的动作和动作。
Description_EN: Makes bots copy your movement and actions.

Name: bot_pistols_only
Description: 限制Bot只能使用手枪。
Description_EN: Restricts bots to pistols only.

Name: bot_place
Description: 将Bot移动到您正在查看的位置。
Description_EN: Moves a bot to the spot you are looking at.

Name: bot_quota
Description: 设置服务器在游戏中保留的Bot数量。
Description_EN: Sets the number of bots the server keeps in the game.

Name: bot_quota_mode
Description: 控制 bot_quota 的应用方式：固定数量、填充玩家数量或与人数的比率。
Description_EN: Controls how bot_quota is applied: a fixed number, fill to a player count, or a ratio to humans.

Name: bot_snipers_only
Description: 限制Bot只能使用狙击步枪。
Description_EN: Restricts bots to sniper rifles only.

Name: bot_stop
Description: 将所有Bot冻结在原地，使其停止思考和移动。
Description_EN: Freezes all bots in place so they stop thinking and moving.

Name: sv_auto_adjust_bot_difficulty
Description: 切换Bot根据人类的表现改变每回合的难度。
Description_EN: Toggles bots changing their difficulty each round based on how well humans are doing.

Name: changelevel
Description: 将服务器更改为另一张地图，同时保持玩家连接。
Description_EN: Changes the server to another map while keeping connected players.

Name: ds_workshop_changelevel
Description: 按名称从托管集合更改创意工坊地图。
Description_EN: Changes to a Workshop map from the hosted collection by name.

Name: ds_workshop_listmaps
Description: 列出服务器上可用的创意工坊地图。
Description_EN: Lists the Workshop maps available on the server.

Name: game_alias
Description: 使用竞技模式名称一步设置游戏类型和游戏模式。
Description_EN: Sets the game type and game mode in one step using a mode name like competitive.

Name: game_mode
Description: 设置当前 game_type 内的游戏模式，例如竞技或僚机。
Description_EN: Sets the game mode within the current game_type, such as competitive or wingman.

Name: game_type
Description: 设置游戏类型，与 game_mode 一起选择游戏模式。
Description_EN: Sets the game type, which together with game_mode picks the game mode.

Name: host_workshop_collection
Description: 将 Steam 创意工坊集合托管为服务器的地图组。
Description_EN: Hosts a Steam Workshop collection as the server's map group.

Name: host_workshop_map
Description: 根据 ID 下载创意工坊地图并将其加载到服务器上。
Description_EN: Downloads a Workshop map by its ID and loads it on the server.

Name: map
Description: 加载地图并在其上启动新的服务器会话。
Description_EN: Loads a map and starts a new server session on it.

Name: mapgroup
Description: 设置服务器轮换的地图组。
Description_EN: Sets the map group the server rotates through.

Name: maps
Description: 列出服务器上安装的地图。
Description_EN: Lists the maps installed on the server.

Name: mp_dm_teammode
Description: 在混战和团队计分之间切换死亡竞赛。
Description_EN: Switches deathmatch between free-for-all and team scoring.

Name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap
Description: 在比赛结束时切换对下一张地图的投票。
Description_EN: Toggles the vote for the next map at the end of a match.

Name: nextlevel
Description: 设置服务器在比赛结束时将更改为的地图。
Description_EN: Sets the map the server will change to at the end of the match.

Name: sv_accelerate
Description: 设置玩家在地面上达到全速的速度。
Description_EN: Sets how quickly players reach full speed on the ground.

Name: sv_airaccelerate
Description: 设置玩家在空中改变速度和方向的速度。
Description_EN: Sets how quickly players can change speed and direction in the air.

Name: sv_autobunnyhopping
Description: 让玩家在按住跳跃键的同时自动再次跳跃。
Description_EN: Makes players jump again automatically while holding the jump key.

Name: sv_enablebunnyhopping
Description: 取消了跳跃的速度上限，以便玩家可以通过兔子跳跃来获得速度。
Description_EN: Removes the speed cap on jumps so players can gain speed by bunny hopping.

Name: sv_falldamage_scale
Description: 衡量玩家因坠落而受到的伤害。
Description_EN: Scales the damage players take from falling.

Name: sv_friction
Description: 设置当玩家停止移动时减慢玩家速度的地面摩擦力。
Description_EN: Sets the ground friction that slows players when they stop moving.

Name: sv_gravity
Description: 设置世界重力，控制玩家跳跃的高度和物体下落的速度。
Description_EN: Sets the world gravity, which controls how high players jump and how fast things fall.

Name: sv_jump_impulse
Description: 设置跳跃的向上速度，控制跳跃高度。
Description_EN: Sets the upward speed of a jump, which controls jump height.

Name: sv_legacy_jump
Description: 切换回 2026 年机芯更改之前使用的旧跳转代码。
Description_EN: Switches back to the older jump code used before the 2026 movement changes.

Name: sv_maxspeed
Description: 设置玩家可以在地面上奔跑的最大速度。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum speed players can run on the ground.

Name: sv_maxvelocity
Description: 设置每个轴的任何移动物体或玩家的速度限制。
Description_EN: Sets the speed limit for any moving object or player, per axis.

Name: sv_noclipspeed
Description: 设置玩家在 noclip 中的飞行速度。
Description_EN: Sets how fast players fly while in noclip.

Name: sv_staminamax
Description: 设置跳跃和着陆的最大耐力损失。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum stamina penalty from jumping and landing.

Name: ammo_grenade_limit_default
Description: 设置玩家可以携带的每种手榴弹类型的数量。
Description_EN: Sets how many of each other grenade type a player can carry.

Name: ammo_grenade_limit_flashbang
Description: 设置玩家可以携带多少闪光弹。
Description_EN: Sets how many flashbangs a player can carry.

Name: ammo_grenade_limit_total
Description: 设置玩家可以携带的手榴弹总数。
Description_EN: Sets the total number of grenades a player can carry.

Name: ff_damage_reduction_bullets
Description: 设置友军开火时队友受到的子弹伤害。
Description_EN: Sets how much bullet damage teammates take when friendly fire is on.

Name: ff_damage_reduction_grenade
Description: 设置友军开火时队友受到的手榴弹伤害。
Description_EN: Sets how much grenade damage teammates take when friendly fire is on.

Name: inferno_flame_lifetime
Description: 设置燃烧弹的火焰燃烧多长时间（以秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets how long the flames of a molotov burn, in seconds.

Name: mp_ct_default_grenades
Description: 设置每回合都会产生反恐手榴弹。
Description_EN: Sets the grenades Counter-Terrorists spawn with each round.

Name: mp_ct_default_melee
Description: 设置反恐精英生成时使用的近战物品，例如刀或宙斯。
Description_EN: Sets the melee items Counter-Terrorists spawn with, such as the knife or a Zeus.

Name: mp_ct_default_primary
Description: 设置反恐精英每回合生成的主要武器。
Description_EN: Sets the primary weapon Counter-Terrorists spawn with each round.

Name: mp_ct_default_secondary
Description: 设置每回合都会出现手枪反恐分子。
Description_EN: Sets the pistol Counter-Terrorists spawn with each round.

Name: mp_damage_headshot_only
Description: 仅爆头造成伤害。
Description_EN: Makes only headshots deal damage.

Name: mp_damage_vampiric_amount
Description: 治疗攻击者所造成伤害的一小部分。
Description_EN: Heals attackers by a fraction of the damage they deal.

Name: mp_death_drop_gun
Description: 控制玩家死亡时掉落哪把枪。
Description_EN: Controls which gun a player drops on death.

Name: mp_drop_knife_enable
Description: 切换玩家是否可以放下刀。
Description_EN: Toggles whether players can drop their knife.

Name: mp_items_prohibited
Description: 通过物品定义索引禁止特定武器。
Description_EN: Bans specific weapons by their item definition index.

Name: mp_t_default_grenades
Description: 设置每回合都会产生恐怖分子的手榴弹。
Description_EN: Sets the grenades Terrorists spawn with each round.

Name: mp_t_default_primary
Description: 设置每回合产生的恐怖分子的主要武器。
Description_EN: Sets the primary weapon Terrorists spawn with each round.

Name: mp_t_default_secondary
Description: 设置 T 阵营（恐怖分子）每回合开局自带的默认手枪。
Description_EN: Sets the pistol Terrorists spawn with each round.

Name: mp_taser_recharge_time
Description: 设置宙斯在射击后需要多少秒才能重新充电。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds the Zeus takes to recharge after a shot.

Name: sv_hegrenade_damage_multiplier
Description: 衡量 HE 手榴弹的伤害。
Description_EN: Scales the damage of HE grenades.

Name: weapon_accuracy_nospread
Description: 消除了武器的不准确性，使每颗子弹都准确地击中您的目标。
Description_EN: Removes weapon inaccuracy so every bullet goes exactly where you aim.

Name: exec
Description: 运行配置文件，执行其中的每个命令。
Description_EN: Runs a config file, executing every command in it.

Name: hostname
Description: 设置服务器浏览器和记分牌中显示的服务器名称。
Description_EN: Sets the server name shown in the server browser and scoreboard.

Name: log
Description: 打开或关闭服务器日志记录。
Description_EN: Turns server logging on or off.

Name: logaddress_add_http
Description: 通过 HTTP POST 将服务器日志发送到网址。
Description_EN: Sends server logs to a web address by HTTP POST.

Name: mp_logdetail
Description: 控制是否将攻击写入服务器日志。
Description_EN: Controls whether attacks are written to the server log.

Name: pause
Description: 切换服务器的暂停状态。
Description_EN: Toggles the server's pause state.

Name: quit
Description: 立即停止服务器。
Description_EN: Stops the server immediately.

Name: rcon
Description: 向服务器的远程控制台发送命令。
Description_EN: Sends a command to the server's remote console.

Name: rcon_password
Description: 设置远程控制台 (RCON) 访问服务器的密码。
Description_EN: Sets the password for remote console (RCON) access to the server.

Name: status
Description: 显示服务器名称、地图、玩家数量以及每个已连接玩家的用户 ID、ping 和 Steam ID。
Description_EN: Shows the server name, map, player count and every connected player with user ID, ping and Steam ID.

Name: sv_hibernate_when_empty
Description: 当没有人连接时，将服务器置于 CPU 非常低的睡眠模式。
Description_EN: Puts the server into a very low CPU sleep mode when nobody is connected.

Name: sv_kick_players_with_cooldown
Description: 控制是否踢出具有匹配冷却时间或不受信任状态的玩家。
Description_EN: Controls whether players with a matchmaking cooldown or Untrusted status are kicked.

Name: sv_lan
Description: 仅使服务器成为 LAN，没有 Steam 身份验证或互联网列表。
Description_EN: Makes the server LAN only, with no Steam authentication or internet listing.

Name: sv_logfile
Description: 切换将服务器日志写入文件。
Description_EN: Toggles writing server logs to a file.

Name: sv_password
Description: 设置玩家必须输入才能加入服务器的密码。
Description_EN: Sets a password players must enter to join the server.

Name: sv_pausable
Description: 切换是否可以使用pause 和setpause 暂停服务器。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the server can be paused with pause and setpause.

Name: sv_prime_accounts_only
Description: 仅允许 Prime 状态帐户连接到服务器。
Description_EN: Allows only Prime Status accounts to connect to the server.

Name: sv_region
Description: 设置服务器向服务器浏览器报告的区域。
Description_EN: Sets the region the server reports to the server browser.

Name: sv_setsteamaccount
Description: 设置服务器用于登录 Steam 的游戏服务器登录令牌 (GSLT)。
Description_EN: Sets the Game Server Login Token (GSLT) the server uses to log in to Steam.

Name: sv_shutdown
Description: 当前所有游戏结束后关闭服务器。
Description_EN: Shuts the server down once all current games have finished.

Name: sv_tags
Description: 设置在服务器浏览器中描述服务器的标签。
Description_EN: Sets tags that describe the server in the server browser.

Name: sv_visiblemaxplayers
Description: 覆盖向浏览服务器的人显示的最大玩家数量。
Description_EN: Overrides the maximum player count shown to people browsing for servers.

Name: hostport
Description: 设置游戏服务器侦听的端口。
Description_EN: Sets the port the game server listens on.

Name: net_public_adr
Description: 设置 NAT 后面的服务器的公共 IP 地址。
Description_EN: Sets the public IP address for a server behind NAT.

Name: net_status
Description: 显示服务器当前的网络状态。
Description_EN: Shows the current network status of the server.

Name: sv_maxrate
Description: 设置每个玩家可以使用的最大带宽（以每秒字节数为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum bandwidth each player can use, in bytes per second.

Name: sv_maxunlag
Description: 设置最大滞后补偿（以秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum lag compensation in seconds.

Name: sv_minrate
Description: 设置允许每个玩家使用的最小带宽（以字节/秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the minimum bandwidth each player is allowed to use, in bytes per second.

Name: spec_replay_enable
Description: 打开杀手重播，向死亡玩家展示他们是如何死亡的。
Description_EN: Turns on Killer Replay, which shows dead players how they died.

Name: tv_autorecord
Description: 自动将服务器上的每场比赛记录为 GOTV Demo。
Description_EN: Records every match on the server as a GOTV demo automatically.

Name: tv_broadcast
Description: 通过 tv_broadcast_url 中设置的 HTTP 中继广播匹配。
Description_EN: Broadcasts matches through an HTTP relay set in tv_broadcast_url.

Name: tv_delay
Description: 设置 GOTV 广播延迟（以秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the GOTV broadcast delay in seconds.

Name: tv_enable
Description: 打开服务器的内置观众广播和Demo记录器 GOTV。
Description_EN: Turns on GOTV, the server's built-in spectator broadcast and demo recorder.

Name: tv_enable_dynamic
Description: 使对 tv_enable 的更改立即生效，而不是在下一张地图上生效。
Description_EN: Makes changes to tv_enable take effect right away instead of on the next map.

Name: tv_maxclients
Description: 设置 GOTV 的最大观众人数。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum number of spectators on GOTV.

Name: tv_name
Description: 设置 GOTV 在服务器上使用的名称。
Description_EN: Sets the name GOTV uses on the server.

Name: tv_password
Description: 为加入 GOTV 的观众设置密码。
Description_EN: Sets a password for spectators joining GOTV.

Name: tv_port
Description: 设置 GOTV 观众连接的端口。
Description_EN: Sets the port GOTV spectators connect to.

Name: tv_record
Description: 使用您提供的文件名开始录制 GOTV Demo。
Description_EN: Starts recording a GOTV demo with the file name you give.

Name: tv_relayvoice
Description: 切换将玩家语音聊天转发给 GOTV 观众和Demo。
Description_EN: Toggles relaying player voice chat to GOTV spectators and demos.

Name: tv_status
Description: 显示 GOTV 服务器的状态。
Description_EN: Shows the status of the GOTV server.

Name: tv_stoprecord
Description: 停止当前正在录制的 GOTV Demo。
Description_EN: Stops the GOTV demo that is currently recording.

Name: tv_transmitall
Description: 将所有实体发送到 GOTV，而不仅仅是导演摄像机看到的内容。
Description_EN: Sends all entities to GOTV, not only what the director's camera sees.

Name: say
Description: 向所有玩家发送聊天消息。
Description_EN: Sends a chat message to all players.

Name: sv_allchat
Description: 让玩家看到所有文字聊天，对死亡玩家没有任何限制。
Description_EN: Lets players see all text chat, with no restrictions for dead players.

Name: sv_alltalk
Description: 让玩家听到两队的语音聊天。
Description_EN: Lets players hear voice chat from both teams.

Name: sv_deadtalk
Description: 让阵亡玩家通过语音和文字与活着的玩家交谈。
Description_EN: Lets dead players talk to living players by voice and text.

Name: sv_full_alltalk
Description: 让每个玩家，包括观众，都可以与其他玩家交谈。
Description_EN: Lets every player, including spectators, talk to every other player.

Name: sv_spec_hear
Description: 控制观众可以听到的内容。
Description_EN: Controls who spectators can hear.

Name: sv_talk_after_dying_time
Description: 设置玩家死后可以与生者继续交谈的秒数。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds a player can keep talking to the living after dying.

Name: sv_voiceenable
Description: 切换服务器上的语音聊天。
Description_EN: Toggles voice chat on the server.

Name: callvote
Description: 开始对某个问题进行投票，例如踢玩家或更改地图。
Description_EN: Starts a vote on an issue, such as kicking a player or changing the map.

Name: kick
Description: 按名称从服务器中删除玩家。
Description_EN: Removes a player from the server by name.

Name: kickid
Description: 通过用户 ID 或 Steam ID 删除玩家，并向他们显示一条可选消息。
Description_EN: Removes a player by user ID or Steam ID, with an optional message shown to them.

Name: sv_allow_votes
Description: 切换服务器上的玩家投票。
Description_EN: Toggles player voting on the server.

Name: sv_kick_ban_duration
Description: 设置球员在踢球禁令后被禁赛的分钟数。
Description_EN: Sets how many minutes a player stays banned after a kick ban.

Name: sv_vote_issue_kick_allowed
Description: 切换玩家是否可以发起投票来踢某人。
Description_EN: Toggles whether players can start votes to kick someone.

Name: sv_vote_kick_ban_duration
Description: 设置被投票踢出的球员被禁赛的分钟数。
Description_EN: Sets how many minutes a player removed by a vote kick stays banned.

Name: sv_vote_quorum_ratio
Description: 设置必须投赞成票才能通过的玩家比例。
Description_EN: Sets the share of players that must vote yes for a vote to pass.

Name: buddha
Description: 让你在不死的情况下承受伤害。
Description_EN: Lets you take damage without dying.

Name: cl_showpos
Description: 在屏幕顶部显示您的位置、视角和速度；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Shows your position, view angles and speed at the top of the screen; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: cl_sim_grenade_trajectory
Description: 绘制当前手榴弹从您站立的位置投掷时会经过的路径；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Draws the path your current grenade would take if thrown from where you stand; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: endround
Description: 立即结束当前回合。
Description_EN: Ends the current round immediately.

Name: ent_fire
Description: 按名称或类别向地图实体发送输入，例如开门；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Sends an input to map entities by name or class, such as opening doors; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: ent_remove
Description: 按名称、类或索引或您正在查看的实体删除实体。
Description_EN: Removes an entity by name, class or index, or the one you are looking at.

Name: explode
Description: 以爆炸性伤害杀死自己的玩家；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Kills your own player with explosive damage; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: firstperson
Description: 将相机切换回正常的第一人称视图。
Description_EN: Switches the camera back to the normal first-person view.

Name: getpos
Description: 将您当前的位置和视角打印为您可以复制的设定位置和设定线；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Prints your current position and view angles as a setpos and setang line you can copy; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: give
Description: 按类别名称向您提供任何武器或物品，而无需购买。
Description_EN: Hands you any weapon or item by its class name, without buying it.

Name: givecurrentammo
Description: 补充你所持武器的弹药。
Description_EN: Refills the ammo of the weapon you are holding.

Name: god
Description: 切换上帝模式，让你不受伤害。
Description_EN: Toggles god mode, making you take no damage.

Name: host_timescale
Description: 加快或减慢整个游戏的速度。
Description_EN: Speeds up or slows down the whole game.

Name: hurtme
Description: 从你的玩家身上获取指定数量的生命值。
Description_EN: Takes the given amount of health from your player.

Name: impulse
Description: 向游戏引擎发送指定编号的脉冲指令（impulse，Source 引擎执行单次动作的底层机制）。
Description_EN: Sends a numbered impulse command to the game, an old Source mechanism for one-off actions.

Name: kill
Description: 让你自己的玩家立即死亡，这是一种快速重生或重置的方法。
Description_EN: Makes your own player die instantly, a quick way to respawn or reset.

Name: plant_bomb
Description: 将炸弹放置在您正在寻找的地方。
Description_EN: Plants the bomb where you are looking.

Name: respawn_player
Description: 死后让你重生。
Description_EN: Respawns you after death.

Name: setang
Description: 设置玩家视角朝向角：俯仰角 (pitch)、偏航角 (yaw) 及可选翻滚角 (roll)。
Description_EN: Sets your view angles: pitch, yaw and optional roll.

Name: setpos
Description: 将您传送到给定的地图坐标。
Description_EN: Teleports you to the given map coordinates.

Name: sv_grenade_trajectory_prac_pipreview
Description: 显示瞄准时手榴弹落地位置的画中画预览。
Description_EN: Shows a picture-in-picture preview of where your grenade will land while you aim it.

Name: sv_grenade_trajectory_prac_trailtime
Description: 显示这么多秒内投掷手榴弹的路径。
Description_EN: Shows the path of thrown grenades for this many seconds.

Name: sv_rethrow_last_grenade
Description: 从同一地点再次向服务器投掷最后一颗手榴弹。
Description_EN: Throws the last grenade thrown on the server again, from the same spot.

Name: sv_showbullethits
Description: 显示子弹击中玩家的情况，也可选择未命中的情况。
Description_EN: Shows bullet hits on players, and optionally near misses.

Name: sv_showimpacts
Description: 显示子弹击中的位置，客户端影响为红色，服务器影响为蓝色。
Description_EN: Shows where bullets hit, with client impacts in red and server impacts in blue.

Name: sv_showimpacts_time
Description: 设置子弹撞击标记保持可见的秒数。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds bullet impact markers stay visible.

Name: thirdperson
Description: 切换到玩家身后的第三人称摄像头；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Switches to a third-person camera behind your player; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: cl_crosshair_drawoutline
Description: 切换十字准线周围的黑色轮廓，使其在明亮的背景上保持可见。
Description_EN: Toggles a black outline around the crosshair so it stays visible on bright backgrounds.

Name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_maxdist_splitratio
Description: 设置十字准线样式 2 的内部和外部部分之间的十字准线长度的划分方式。
Description_EN: Sets how the crosshair line length is divided between the inner and outer parts with crosshair style 2.

Name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitalpha_innermod
Description: 设置内部十字线分割后的不透明度，从 0 到 1，十字线样式为 2。
Description_EN: Sets the opacity of the inner crosshair lines after they split, from 0 to 1, with crosshair style 2.

Name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitalpha_outermod
Description: 设置外部十字线分割后的不透明度，从 0.3 到 1，十字线样式为 2。
Description_EN: Sets the opacity of the outer crosshair lines after they split, from 0.3 to 1, with crosshair style 2.

Name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitdist
Description: 设置十字准线样式 2 中外部十字准线距中心的距离。
Description_EN: Sets how far the outer crosshair lines split away from the center with crosshair style 2.

Name: cl_crosshair_friendly_warning
Description: 当您瞄准队友时，切换准星上显示的警告图标。
Description_EN: Toggles the warning icon shown on your crosshair when you aim at a teammate.

Name: cl_crosshair_outlinethickness
Description: 设置黑色十字线轮廓的粗细，从 0 到 3。
Description_EN: Sets how thick the black crosshair outline is, from 0 to 3.

Name: cl_crosshair_recoil
Description: 切换在您输出调试日志时十字准线是否跟随武器的后坐力。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the crosshair follows your weapon's recoil while you spray.

Name: cl_crosshair_sniper_width
Description: 设置狙击瞄准线的宽度； 1是单像素细线，值越高越粗。
Description_EN: Sets the width of the sniper scope lines; 1 is a single-pixel hairline, higher values are thicker.

Name: cl_crosshair_t
Description: 切换 T 形十字准线，从而删除顶线。
Description_EN: Toggles the T-shaped crosshair, which removes the top line.

Name: cl_crosshairalpha
Description: 将十字线透明度设置为从 0（不可见）到 255（完全实心）。
Description_EN: Sets crosshair transparency from 0 (invisible) to 255 (fully solid).

Name: cl_crosshaircolor
Description: 从预设列表中设置十字准线颜色，或设置 5 以使用您自己的 RGB 值。
Description_EN: Sets the crosshair color from a preset list, or 5 to use your own RGB values.

Name: cl_crosshaircolor_b
Description: 设置自定义十字线颜色的蓝色部分，范围为 0 到 255。
Description_EN: Sets the blue part of a custom crosshair color, from 0 to 255.

Name: cl_crosshaircolor_g
Description: 设置自定义十字准线颜色的绿色部分，范围为 0 到 255。
Description_EN: Sets the green part of a custom crosshair color, from 0 to 255.

Name: cl_crosshaircolor_r
Description: 设置自定义十字准线颜色的红色部分，范围为 0 到 255。
Description_EN: Sets the red part of a custom crosshair color, from 0 to 255.

Name: cl_crosshairdot
Description: 切换十字线中心的一个点。
Description_EN: Toggles a dot in the center of the crosshair.

Name: cl_crosshairgap
Description: 设置十字准线与中心之间的间距；负值使线条靠得更近。
Description_EN: Sets the space between the crosshair lines and the center; negative values pull the lines closer together.

Name: cl_crosshairgap_useweaponvalue
Description: 切换十字线间隙是否根据您持有的武器而变化。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the crosshair gap changes depending on the weapon you hold.

Name: cl_crosshairstyle
Description: 设置十字准线样式，例如静态、具有固定中心的动态或具有假后坐力的传统样式。
Description_EN: Sets the crosshair style, such as static, dynamic with a fixed center, or the legacy style with fake recoil.

Name: cl_crosshairthickness
Description: 设置绘制十字线的粗细。
Description_EN: Sets how thick the crosshair lines are drawn.

Name: cl_crosshairusealpha
Description: 切换十字线是否使用 cl_crosshairalpha 中设置的透明度。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the crosshair uses the transparency set in cl_crosshairalpha.

Name: cl_show_observer_crosshair
Description: 控制您是否看到正在观看的玩家的十字准线：关闭、仅好友或所有人。
Description_EN: Controls whether you see the crosshair of the player you are spectating: off, friends only, or everyone.

Name: crosshair
Description: 完全显示或隐藏您的十字准线。
Description_EN: Shows or hides your crosshair entirely.

Name: r_drawviewmodel
Description: 显示或隐藏你的武器和手部模型；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Shows or hides your weapon and hands model; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: viewmodel_offset_randomize
Description: 切换随机视图模型偏移以预览允许的范围；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Toggles random viewmodel offsets to preview the allowed range; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: viewmodel_offset_x
Description: 沿 X 轴（左和右）移动武器模型。
Description_EN: Moves your weapon model along the X axis (left and right).

Name: viewmodel_offset_y
Description: 沿 Y 轴（向前和向后）移动武器模型。
Description_EN: Moves your weapon model along the Y axis (forward and back).

Name: viewmodel_offset_z
Description: 沿 Z 轴（上下）移动武器模型。
Description_EN: Moves your weapon model along the Z axis (up and down).

Name: viewmodel_presetpos
Description: 应用预设武器位置：1 桌面、2 沙发或 3 经典。
Description_EN: Applies a preset weapon position: 1 Desktop, 2 Couch or 3 Classic.

Name: cl_color
Description: 设置您希望在竞技比赛中获得的队友颜色。
Description_EN: Sets the teammate color you would like to get in competitive matches.

Name: cl_draw_only_deathnotices
Description: 隐藏除十字准线和杀戮饲料之外的 HUD，无需作弊。
Description_EN: Hides the HUD except for the crosshair and kill feed, without needing cheats.

Name: cl_drawhud
Description: 显示或隐藏整个HUD；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Shows or hides the whole HUD; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: cl_drawhud_force_radar
Description: 即使 HUD 隐藏，也强制雷达显示，或强制关闭。
Description_EN: Forces the radar to show even with the HUD hidden, or forces it off.

Name: cl_hud_color
Description: 设置 HUD 元素的颜色，如生命值、装甲和弹药，从团队颜色到十一个预设之一。
Description_EN: Sets the color of the HUD elements like health, armor and ammo, from team color to one of eleven presets.

Name: cl_hud_radar_scale
Description: 设置 HUD 角落雷达框的大小。
Description_EN: Sets the size of the radar box in the corner of the HUD.

Name: cl_radar_always_centered
Description: 切换雷达是否让您处于中心位置，或使用地图边缘附近的完整雷达区域。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the radar keeps you in the center, or uses the full radar area near map edges.

Name: cl_radar_icon_scale_min
Description: 设置雷达上玩家图标的最小尺寸，从 0.4 到 1.25。
Description_EN: Sets the minimum size of player icons on the radar, from 0.4 to 1.25.

Name: cl_radar_rotate
Description: 切换雷达是随您的视野旋转还是在北朝上保持固定。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the radar rotates with your view or stays fixed with north up.

Name: cl_radar_scale
Description: 将雷达变焦设置为0.25至1.0；较低的值会放大，较高的值会显示地图的更多部分。
Description_EN: Sets the radar zoom from 0.25 to 1.0; lower values zoom in, higher values show more of the map.

Name: cl_radar_square_with_scoreboard
Description: 切换记分板打开时雷达是否切换到更大的方形地图。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the radar switches to a larger square map while the scoreboard is open.

Name: cl_showloadout
Description: 切换您的武器和手榴弹列表是否始终在 HUD 上可见。
Description_EN: Toggles whether your weapon and grenade list stays visible on the HUD all the time.

Name: cl_teamid_overhead_colors_show
Description: 切换以每个队友自己的颜色在头顶上绘制队友标记。
Description_EN: Toggles drawing the teammate markers above heads in each teammate's own color.

Name: cl_teamid_overhead_mode
Description: 设置队友头顶上显示的内容：只是一个标记，或者一个带有名称和装备的标记。
Description_EN: Sets what appears above teammates' heads: just a marker, or a marker with name and equipment.

Name: cl_teammate_colors_show
Description: 控制队友是否在雷达和记分牌上获得自己的颜色，以及是否添加字母。
Description_EN: Controls whether teammates get their own colors on the radar and scoreboard, and whether letters are added.

Name: hidehud
Description: 使用位掩码隐藏选定的 HUD 元素，4 隐藏所有内容；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Hides selected HUD elements using a bitmask, 4 hides everything; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: hud_scaling
Description: 设置HUD的整体尺寸；值越低，生命值、弹药和其他元素就越小。
Description_EN: Sets the overall size of the HUD; lower values make health, ammo and other elements smaller.

Name: hud_showtargetid
Description: 当您的十字准线位于其他玩家上方时切换显示的名称。
Description_EN: Toggles the name shown when your crosshair is over another player.

Name: safezonex
Description: 设置HUD使用多少屏幕宽度；较低的值将 HUD 元素从侧面拉入。
Description_EN: Sets how much of the screen width the HUD uses; lower values pull HUD elements in from the sides.

Name: safezoney
Description: 设置HUD使用多少屏幕高度；较低的值将 HUD 元素从顶部和底部拉入。
Description_EN: Sets how much of the screen height the HUD uses; lower values pull HUD elements in from top and bottom.

Name: cl_buywheel_nonumberpurchasing
Description: 切换阻止数字键购买购买菜单中的商品。
Description_EN: Toggles blocking number keys from buying items in the buy menu.

Name: cl_inventory_radial_immediate_select
Description: 切换武器径向菜单是否在光标突出显示某个项目时立即选择该项目。
Description_EN: Toggles whether weapon radial menus select an item as soon as the cursor highlights it.

Name: cl_silencer_mode
Description: 控制是否可以拆下消音器：0 无法拆下，1 二次开火将其拆下。
Description_EN: Controls whether you can take the silencer off: 0 cannot detach, 1 secondary fire detaches it.

Name: cl_sniper_auto_rezoom
Description: 切换狙击步枪是否在每次射击后自动放大。
Description_EN: Toggles whether a sniper rifle zooms back in automatically after each shot.

Name: cl_use_opens_buy_menu
Description: 切换使用键是否也打开购买区域内的购买菜单。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the use key also opens the buy menu inside a buy zone.

Name: input_button_code_is_scan_code
Description: 通过键的物理位置而不是键上打印的字母来切换绑定键。
Description_EN: Toggles binding keys by their physical position instead of the letter printed on them.

Name: joystick
Description: 切换控制器和操纵杆输入。
Description_EN: Toggles controller and joystick input.

Name: m_pitch
Description: 设置鼠标垂直移动在灵敏度之前上下移动视图的程度。
Description_EN: Sets how much vertical mouse movement turns your view up and down, before sensitivity.

Name: m_yaw
Description: 设置鼠标水平移动使您转向的程度，以灵敏度之前的每只鼠标计数的度数表示。
Description_EN: Sets how much horizontal mouse movement turns you, as degrees per mouse count before sensitivity.

Name: mouse_inverty
Description: 切换倒置的垂直鼠标外观，因此向上移动鼠标看起来向下。
Description_EN: Toggles inverted vertical mouse look, so moving the mouse up looks down.

Name: option_duck_method
Description: 将蹲伏设置为保持 (0) 或切换 (1)。
Description_EN: Sets crouch to hold (0) or toggle (1).

Name: option_speed_method
Description: 将行走设置为保持 (0) 或切换 (1)。
Description_EN: Sets walk to hold (0) or toggle (1).

Name: sensitivity
Description: 设置鼠标灵敏度；它与鼠标 DPI 一起决定每英寸转动的距离。
Description_EN: Sets your mouse sensitivity; together with your mouse DPI it decides how far you turn per inch.

Name: zoom_sensitivity_ratio
Description: 使用狙击枪或其他变焦武器瞄准时调整鼠标灵敏度。
Description_EN: Scales your mouse sensitivity while scoped in with a sniper or other zoom weapon.

Name: +lookatweapon
Description: 检查你当前的武器，检查键后面的操作，默认为 F。
Description_EN: Inspects your current weapon, the action behind the inspect key, F by default.

Name: +radialradio
Description: 按住时打开聊天轮，进行快速无线电呼叫和 ping。
Description_EN: Opens the chat wheel while held, for quick radio calls and pings.

Name: +spray_menu
Description: 握住时打开涂鸦轮，以便您可以拾取和放置喷雾。
Description_EN: Opens the graffiti wheel while held, so you can pick and place a spray.

Name: autobuy
Description: 如果你买得起的话，会按照 cl_autobuy 中列出的顺序自动购买物品。
Description_EN: Buys items automatically in the order listed in cl_autobuy, if you can afford them.

Name: bind
Description: 将命令分配给某个键，以便按下该键即可运行该命令；仅用一个键即可显示当前绑定。
Description_EN: Assigns a command to a key so pressing the key runs it; with only a key it shows the current binding.

Name: binddefaults
Description: 将所有按键绑定重置为游戏的默认布局。
Description_EN: Resets all key bindings to the game's default layout.

Name: cl_autobuy
Default: vesthelm vest m4a1 ak47 famas galilar mp7 nova defuser
Description: 设置自动购买命令尝试购买的项目的列表和顺序。
Description_EN: Sets the list and order of items the autobuy command tries to purchase.

Name: cl_rebuy
Default: Armor PrimaryWeapon Flashbang SmokeGrenade Defuser HEGrenade Flashbang SecondaryWeapon Molotov IncGrenade Decoy Taser
Description: 设置重新购买命令重新购买上一回合物品的顺序。
Description_EN: Sets the order in which the rebuy command repurchases your last round's items.

Name: host_writeconfig
Description: 立即将当前设置和按键绑定保存到配置文件中。
Description_EN: Saves your current settings and key binds to your config files right away.

Name: key_listboundkeys
Description: 列出具有绑定的每个键及其运行的命令。
Description_EN: Lists every key that has a binding, along with the command it runs.

Name: lastinv
Description: 切换回之前持有的武器，默认快速切换Q。
Description_EN: Switches back to the weapon you held before, the quick switch on Q by default.

Name: rebuy
Description: 按照 cl_rebuy 中设置的顺序再次购买上一回合购买的物品。
Description_EN: Buys again what you bought last round, in the order set in cl_rebuy.

Name: slot1
Description: 切换到你的主要武器；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your primary weapon; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot10
Description: 切换到你的燃烧弹或燃烧弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your Molotov or incendiary grenade; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot2
Description: 切换到你的辅助武器；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your secondary weapon; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot3
Description: 切换到你的刀；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your knife; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot4
Description: 切换到你的手榴弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your grenades; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot5
Description: 切换到你的C4炸弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your C4 bomb; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot6
Description: 切换到你的高爆手榴弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your HE grenade; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot7
Description: 切换到你的闪光弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your flashbang; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot8
Description: 切换到你的烟雾弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your smoke grenade; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: slot9
Description: 切换到你的诱饵手榴弹；将其绑定到一个键以直接选择武器。
Description_EN: Switches to your decoy grenade; bind it to a key for direct weapon selection.

Name: toggle
Description: 在 0 和 1 之间切换设置，或在列出的值之间循环。
Description_EN: Switches a setting between 0 and 1, or cycles it through the values you list.

Name: unbind
Description: 删除绑定到按键的命令。
Description_EN: Removes the command bound to a key.

Name: unbindall
Description: 立即删除所有键绑定，包括控制台键和移动键。
Description_EN: Removes every key binding at once, including the console key and movement keys.

Name: cl_disable_ragdolls
Description: 为阵亡玩家切换布娃娃物理系统 (Ragdoll)；需要 sv_cheats 1。
Description_EN: Toggles ragdoll physics for dead players; requires sv_cheats 1.

Name: cl_ragdoll_limit
Description: 设置一次显示的最大尸体数量； -1 取消限制。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum number of dead bodies shown at once; -1 removes the limit.

Name: cq_netgraph
Description: 在 HUD 上显示命令队列统计信息，有助于发现网络和计时问题。
Description_EN: Shows command queue statistics on the HUD, useful for spotting network and timing problems.

Name: engine_no_focus_sleep
Description: 设置游戏在不是焦点窗口时每帧休眠的毫秒数。
Description_EN: Sets how many milliseconds the game sleeps each frame while it is not the focused window.

Name: fps_max
Description: 限制游戏过程中的帧速率； 0 取消限制。
Description_EN: Caps your frame rate during gameplay; 0 removes the limit.

Name: fps_max_ui
Description: 当菜单和游戏 UI 打开时限制帧速率； 0 取消限制。
Description_EN: Caps your frame rate while menus and the game UI are open; 0 removes the limit.

Name: r_fullscreen_gamma
Description: 设置全屏模式下的屏幕伽玛值，即亮度滑块后面的值。
Description_EN: Sets screen gamma in fullscreen mode, the value behind the brightness slider.

Name: r_player_visibility_mode
Description: 切换可增强玩家对比度，使玩家模型从背景中脱颖而出。
Description_EN: Toggles boost player contrast, which makes player models stand out from the background.

Name: r_show_build_info
Description: 切换屏幕一角显示的构建信息文本。
Description_EN: Toggles the build information text shown in the corner of the screen.

Name: cl_clutch_mode
Description: 切换离合器模式，使声音和其他分散注意力的声音静音，直到回合结束或您死亡。
Description_EN: Toggles clutch mode, which silences voice and other distracting sounds until the round ends or you die.

Name: cl_mute_all_but_friends_and_party
Description: 阻止除 Steam 好友和队伍成员之外的所有人的语音和聊天。
Description_EN: Blocks voice and chat from everyone except Steam friends and party members.

Name: cl_mute_enemy_team
Description: 切换阻止敌方团队的所有语音和文本聊天。
Description_EN: Toggles blocking all voice and text chat from the enemy team.

Name: clutch_mode_toggle
Description: 打开或关闭离合模式，非常适合离合期间的按键绑定。
Description_EN: Turns clutch mode on or off, ideal for a key bind during a clutch.

Name: say_team
Description: 仅向您自己的团队发送聊天消息。
Description_EN: Sends a chat message only to your own team.

Name: snd_deathcamera_volume
Description: 设置你死后死亡摄像机播放的音乐的音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the death camera after you die.

Name: snd_headphone_eq
Description: 选择耳机均衡器预设、声音设置中的音频配置文件选项。
Description_EN: Selects the headphone EQ preset, the audio profile option in the sound settings.

Name: snd_mapobjective_volume
Description: 设置为地图目标（例如放置炸弹）播放的音乐音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the map objectives such as a planted bomb.

Name: snd_menumusic_volume
Description: 设置主菜单和其他非游戏屏幕播放音乐的音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the main menu and other non-gameplay screens.

Name: snd_musicvolume
Description: 设置整体音乐音量，缩放所有单独的音乐滑块。
Description_EN: Sets the overall music volume, which scales all the separate music sliders.

Name: snd_mute_mvp_music_live_players
Description: 当两支球队的球员都还活着时，切换静音 MVP 音乐。
Description_EN: Toggles muting MVP music while players from both teams are still alive.

Name: snd_mvp_volume
Description: 设置本轮 MVP 播放的音乐音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the round MVP.

Name: snd_roundaction_volume
Description: 设置一轮中动作时刻播放的音乐音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the action moments during a round.

Name: snd_roundend_volume
Description: 设置当您的球队获胜或失败时一轮结束时播放的音乐音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the end of a round when your team wins or loses.

Name: snd_roundstart_volume
Description: 设置每回合开始时播放的音乐音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the start of each round.

Name: snd_tensecondwarning_volume
Description: 设置当回合或炸弹计时器还剩 10 秒时发出警告的音乐音量。
Description_EN: Sets the volume of the music played for the warning when 10 seconds are left on the round or bomb timer.

Name: snd_voipvolume
Description: 设置其他玩家语音聊天的声音大小。
Description_EN: Sets how loud other players' voice chat is.

Name: voice_loopback
Description: 切换在游戏中听到自己的声音，以测试您的麦克风。
Description_EN: Toggles hearing your own voice through the game, to test your microphone.

Name: voice_modenable
Description: 切换游戏中的语音聊天：听到其他人说话。
Description_EN: Toggles voice chat in the game: hearing others and talking.

Name: voice_threshold
Description: 设置游戏将麦克风输入视为语音之前的声音大小。
Description_EN: Sets how loud your microphone input must be before the game treats it as speech.

Name: voice_vox
Description: 切换打开麦克风，这样您的麦克风就可以一直传输信号，而无需按键通话。
Description_EN: Toggles open mic, so your microphone transmits all the time without push to talk.

Name: volume
Description: 设置主游戏音量，从 0（静音）到 1（全）。
Description_EN: Sets the master game volume, from 0 (muted) to 1 (full).

Name: cl_timeout
Description: 设置游戏自行断开连接之前服务器没有数据传输的秒数。
Description_EN: Sets how many seconds without data from the server pass before your game disconnects itself.

Name: connect
Description: 通过 IP 地址和端口直接加入游戏服务器。
Description_EN: Joins a game server directly by its IP address and port.

Name: disconnect
Description: 离开您连接的服务器并返回主菜单。
Description_EN: Leaves the server you are connected to and returns to the main menu.

Name: mm_dedicated_search_maxping
Description: 设置匹配寻找官方服务器时您接受的最高 ping。
Description_EN: Sets the highest ping you accept when matchmaking looks for official servers.

Name: net_client_steamdatagram_enable_override
Description: 强制您连接到服务器的方式：通过 Valve 的中继网络、直接连接或默认匹配。
Description_EN: Forces how you connect to servers: through Valve's relay network, directly, or the matchmaking default.

Name: net_fakelag
Description: 添加以毫秒为单位的虚假网络延迟，用于测试游戏在较差连接情况下的运行情况。
Description_EN: Adds fake network lag in milliseconds, for testing how the game plays with a worse connection.

Name: net_print_sdr_ping_times
Description: 在控制台打印玩家到 Valve 中继服务器 (SDR) 各节点的延迟及游戏当前选定的路由链路。
Description_EN: Prints your ping to Valve's relay locations and the route the game picked.

Name: password
Description: 设置您的游戏在加入受密码保护的服务器时发送的密码。
Description_EN: Sets the password your game sends when joining a password-protected server.

Name: rate
Description: 设置游戏从服务器接受的最大网络数据速率（以字节/秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Sets the maximum network data rate your game accepts from the server, in bytes per second.

Name: csgo_download_match
Description: 通过共享代码下载比赛并开始比赛。
Description_EN: Downloads a match by its share code and starts playing it.

Name: demo_gototick
Description: 跳转到正在播放的Demo中的特定Tick。
Description_EN: Jumps to a specific tick in the demo that is playing.

Name: demo_info
Description: 打印有关正在播放的Demo的信息，包括当前的Tick。
Description_EN: Prints information about the demo that is playing, including the current tick.

Name: demo_pause
Description: 暂停Demo 回放。
Description_EN: Pauses demo playback.

Name: demo_resume
Description: 恢复暂停的Demo。
Description_EN: Resumes a paused demo.

Name: demo_timescale
Description: 设置Demo 回放速度，例如 0.5 表示半速，2 表示双倍速。
Description_EN: Sets the demo playback speed, for example 0.5 for half speed or 2 for double.

Name: demo_togglepause
Description: 暂停或恢复Demo 回放，只需一个键即可轻松实现。
Description_EN: Pauses or resumes demo playback, handy on a single key.

Name: demoui
Description: 显示或隐藏Demo 回放控件，也可以使用 Shift+F2 打开。
Description_EN: Shows or hides the demo playback controls, also opened with Shift+F2.

Name: playdemo
Description: 播放游戏文件夹中录制的Demo 录像文件 (.dem)。
Description_EN: Plays back a recorded demo file (.dem) from the game folder.

Name: record
Description: 开始录制您所在游戏的Demo，保存为 .dem 文件。
Description_EN: Starts recording a demo of the game you are in, saved as a .dem file.

Name: stop
Description: 结束您从录制开始的Demo录制并保存文件。
Description_EN: Ends the demo recording you started with record and saves the file.

Name: timedemo
Description: 尽可能快地播放 Demo并报告您的平均帧速率（一个常见的基准）。
Description_EN: Plays a demo as fast as possible and reports your average frame rate, a common benchmark.

Name: cl_autohelp
Description: 为新玩家切换自动帮助消息。
Description_EN: Toggles automatic help messages for new players.

Name: cl_dm_buyrandomweapons
Description: 在死亡竞赛中每次生成时自动切换获得随机武器。
Description_EN: Toggles getting a random weapon automatically on each spawn in deathmatch.

Name: cl_hide_avatar_images
Description: 隐藏其他玩家的头像图片：全部，或除好友外的全部。
Description_EN: Hides other players' avatar pictures: all, or all except friends.

Name: cl_join_advertise
Description: 控制 Steam 好友是否可以在游戏进行中直接加入对局：允许所有服务器、仅限官方服务器或从不允许。
Description_EN: Controls whether Steam friends can join your game in progress: on all servers, official servers only, or never.

Name: cl_playerspraydisable
Description: 切换是否屏蔽/隐藏其他玩家喷涂的涂鸦图案。
Description_EN: Toggles hiding graffiti sprays from other players.

Name: cl_sanitize_muted_players
Description: 切换隐藏已静音的玩家的姓名和头像。
Description_EN: Toggles hiding names and avatars of players you have muted.

Name: cl_sanitize_player_names
Description: 切换用中性名称替换其他玩家的名称，这对于直播很有用。
Description_EN: Toggles replacing other players' names with neutral names, useful for streaming.

Name: clear
Description: 清空控制台当前显示的所有历史文本内容。
Description_EN: Empties all text from the console.

Name: con_enable
Description: 切换是否可以打开开发人员控制台，即“启用开发人员控制台”设置。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the developer console can be opened, the Enable Developer Console setting.

Name: condump
Description: 将当前控制台文本保存到游戏文件夹中的 condump 日志文件中。
Description_EN: Saves the current console text to a condump log file in the game folder.

Name: dm_togglerandomweapons
Description: 打开或关闭死亡竞赛中的随机武器。
Description_EN: Turns random weapons in deathmatch on or off.

Name: gameinstructor_enable
Description: 切换游戏中的课程和提示来教导新玩家。
Description_EN: Toggles the in-game lessons and hints that teach new players.

Name: map_workshop
Description: 在本地游戏上按 ID 加载 Steam 创意工坊地图。
Description_EN: Loads a Steam Workshop map by its ID on a local game.

Name: spec_replay_autostart
Description: 切换杀手重播是否在你死亡后自动开始（如果可用）。
Description_EN: Toggles whether the killer replay starts automatically after you die, when available.

Name: spec_show_xray
Description: 在您观看比赛时，通过墙壁切换 X 射线轮廓和球员姓名。
Description_EN: Toggles X-ray outlines and names of players through walls while you spectate.

Name: toggleconsole
Description: 打开或关闭开发者控制台，控制台键后面的命令。
Description_EN: Opens or closes the developer console, the command behind the console key.

Name: alias
Description: 创建运行一个或多个命令的快捷方式名称。
Description_EN: Creates a shortcut name that runs one or more commands.

Name: cvarlist
Description: 列出所有命令和设置，可以选择按前缀过滤。
Description_EN: Lists all commands and settings, optionally filtered by a prefix.

Name: differences
Description: 列出所有非默认值的设置。
Description_EN: Lists every setting that is not at its default value.

Name: echo
Description: 将文本打印到控制台。
Description_EN: Prints text to the console.

Name: find
Description: 搜索每个命令和设置的名称或描述中的文本。
Description_EN: Searches every command and setting for text in its name or description.

Name: help
Description: 显示命令或设置的帮助文本、标志和当前值。
Description_EN: Shows the help text, flags and current value of a command or setting.

Name: mp_anyone_can_pickup_c4
Description: 若已设置，的话，每个人都可以拿起c4，而不仅仅是Ts。
Description_EN: If set, everyone can pick up the c4, not just Ts.

Name: mp_backup_restore_load_autopause
Description: 备份恢复回合数据后是否自动暂停比赛
Description_EN: Whether to automatically pause the match after restoring round data from backup

Name: mp_backup_round_auto
Description: 如果启用，即使备份文件未写入磁盘，也会保留内存备份以处理重新连接的玩家
Description_EN: If enabled will keep in-memory backups to handle reconnecting players even if the backup files aren't written to disk

Name: mp_backup_round_file_last
Description: 每次写入备份文件时，都会更新此 convar 的值以保存备份文件的名称。
Description_EN: Every time a backup file is written the value of this convar gets updated to hold the name of the backup file.

Name: mp_backup_round_file_pattern
Description: 若已设置，那么服务器会将所有已玩的回合信息保存到以此模式命名的文件中，...
Description_EN: If set then server will save all played rounds information to files named by this pattern,...

Name: mp_bot_ai_bt
Description: 使用指定的行为树文件来驱动Bot行为。
Description_EN: Use the specified behavior tree file to drive the bot behavior.

Name: mp_bot_ai_bt_clear_cache
Description: 清除行为树文件的缓存。
Description_EN: Clears the cache for behavior tree files.

Name: mp_c4_cannot_be_defused
Description: 若已设置，则植入的 c4 无法被解除。
Description_EN: If set, the planted c4 cannot be defused.

Name: mp_competitive_endofmatch_extra_time
Description: 一场竞技比赛结束后，将给予加时投票以决定排名。
Description_EN: After a competitive match finishes rematch voting extra time is given for rankings.

Name: mp_consecutive_loss_aversion
Description: 连败对回合胜利的影响：0 = 胜利完全重置损失奖金，1 = 首场胜利减少损失奖金，2 = 首场胜利保留损失奖金...
Description_EN: How loss streak is affected with round win: 0 = win fully resets loss bonus, 1 = first win steps down loss bonus, 2 = first win holds loss bonus...

Name: mp_consecutive_loss_max
Description: 游戏本身列表中没有描述的设置。
Description_EN: Setting with no description in the game's own list.

Name: mp_coopmission_bot_difficulty_offset
Description: 合作任务期间Bot的难度补偿修正。
Description_EN: The difficulty offset modifier for bots during coop missions.

Name: mp_damage_scale_ct_body
Description: 当 CT 玩家受到身体伤害时，他们所受到的伤害会按此比例调整。
Description_EN: Scales the damage a CT player takes by this much when they take damage in the body.

Name: mp_damage_scale_ct_head
Description: 当 CT 玩家头部受到伤害时，将他们受到的伤害按此比例调整（1 == 100%，0.5 == 50%）。
Description_EN: Scales the damage a CT player takes by this much when they take damage in the head (1 == 100%, 0.5 == 50%).

Name: mp_damage_scale_t_body
Description: 当 T 玩家的身体受到伤害时，他们所受到的伤害会按此比例调整。
Description_EN: Scales the damage a T player takes by this much when they take damage in the body.

Name: mp_damage_scale_t_head
Description: 当 T 玩家头部受到伤害时，将他们受到的伤害按此比例调整（1 == 100%，0.5 == 50%）。
Description_EN: Scales the damage a T player takes by this much when they take damage in the head (1 == 100%, 0.5 == 50%).

Name: mp_death_drop_c4
Description: c4是否可掉落
Description_EN: Whether c4 is droppable

Name: mp_death_drop_defuser
Description: 玩家死亡时掉落拆除器
Description_EN: Drop defuser on player death

Name: mp_death_drop_grenade
Description: 玩家死亡时掉落哪种手榴弹：0=无，1=最佳，2=当前或最佳，3=所有手榴弹
Description_EN: Which grenade to drop on player death: 0=none, 1=best, 2=current or best, 3=all grenades

Name: mp_death_drop_healthshot
Description: 玩家死亡时掉落生命射击
Description_EN: Drop healthshot on player death

Name: mp_death_drop_taser
Description: 玩家死亡时掉落泰瑟枪
Description_EN: Drop taser on player death

Name: mp_deathcam_skippable
Description: 确定玩家是否可以提前退出死亡摄像机。
Description_EN: Determines whether a player can early-out of the deathcam.

Name: mp_default_team_winner_no_objective
Description: 如果地图没有定义目标（炸弹、人质等），则该 convar 的值将在回合时间耗尽时宣布获胜者。
Description_EN: If the map doesn't define an objective (bomb, hostage, etc), the value of this convar will declare the winner when the time runs out in the round.

Name: mp_disable_autokick
Description: 防止用户 ID 被自动踢出
Description_EN: Prevents a userid from being auto-kicked

Name: mp_disconnect_kills_bots
Description: 当Bot断开连接时，请先杀死它们。
Description_EN: When a bot disconnects, kill them first.

Name: mp_disconnect_kills_players
Description: 当玩家断开连接时，先杀死他们（触发物品掉落、统计数据等）
Description_EN: When a player disconnects, kill them first (triggering item drops, stats, etc.)

Name: mp_display_kill_assists
Description: 是否显示球员助攻并得分
Description_EN: Whether to display and score player assists

Name: mp_dm_bonus_length_max
Description: 奖励时间持续的最长时间（以秒为单位）
Description_EN: Maximum time the bonus time will last (in seconds)

Name: mp_dm_bonus_length_min
Description: 奖励时间持续的最短时间（以秒为单位）
Description_EN: Minimum time the bonus time will last (in seconds)

Name: mp_dm_bonus_percent
Description: 当某人在奖励期内使用奖励武器击杀时额外奖励的分数百分比。
Description_EN: Percent of points additionally awarded when someone gets a kill with the bonus weapon during the bonus period.

Name: mp_dm_bonusweapon_dogtags
Description: 使用奖励武器击杀时会掉落额外的狗牌
Description_EN: Additional dogtags to drop when making a kill with the bonus weapon

Name: mp_dm_dogtag_score
Description: 在死亡竞赛中拾取狗牌可获得奖励积分。
Description_EN: Points to award for picking up a dogtag in deathmatch.

Name: mp_dm_healthshot_killcount
Description: 在死亡竞赛中击杀 n 次后获得健康射击
Description_EN: Grant healthshots in deathmatch after n kills

Name: mp_dm_kill_base_score
Description: 在死亡竞赛中击杀后奖励的基本点数。
Description_EN: Number of base points to award for a kill in deathmatch.

Name: mp_dm_taser_bonus_streak_max
Description: 单次泰瑟枪连续击杀得分的最大倍数。
Description_EN: Maximum times to multiply the score for getting a streak of taser kills in a single life.

Name: mp_dm_teammode_bonus_score
Description: 团队死亡竞赛胜利点奖励使用奖励武器击杀
Description_EN: Team deathmatch victory points to award for kill with bonus weapon

Name: mp_dm_teammode_dogtag_score
Description: 团队死亡竞赛胜利积分可奖励收集敌人的狗牌
Description_EN: Team deathmatch victory points to award for collecting enemy dogtags

Name: mp_dm_teammode_kill_score
Description: 团队死亡竞赛胜利分数奖励杀死敌人
Description_EN: Team deathmatch victory points to award for enemy kill

Name: mp_dm_time_between_bonus_max
Description: 奖励时间在回合开始后或最后一次奖励后开始的最长时间（以秒为单位）
Description_EN: Maximum time a bonus time will start after the round start or after the last bonus (in seconds)

Name: mp_dm_time_between_bonus_min
Description: 奖励时间在回合开始后或最后一次奖励后开始的最短时间（以秒为单位）
Description_EN: Minimum time a bonus time will start after the round start or after the last bonus (in seconds)

Name: mp_dogtag_despawn_on_killer_death
Description: 当凶手死亡时，狗牌是否应该消失
Description_EN: Whether dogtags should despawn when their killer dies

Name: mp_dogtag_despawn_time
Description: 自动消失前狗牌应停留多少秒（0 = 无限）
Description_EN: How many seconds dogtags should stay around before despawning automatically (0 = infinite)

Name: mp_dogtag_pickup_rule
Description: 谁有资格领取狗牌（0 = 仅凶手，1 = 凶手团队，2 = 受害者团队，3 = 凶手和受害者团队，4 = 任何人）
Description_EN: Who is eligible to pick up a dogtag (0 = killer only, 1 = killer's team, 2 = victim's team, 3 = killer & victim's team, 4 = anyone)

Name: mp_drop_grenade_enable
Description: 允许玩家投掷手榴弹。
Description_EN: Allows players to drop grenades.

Name: mp_economy_reset_rounds
Description: 每 N 轮重置所有玩家资金（0 表示从不）
Description_EN: Reset all player money every N rounds (0 for never)

Name: mp_endmatch_votenextleveltime
Description: 若已设置，了 mp_endmatch_votenextmap，则玩家有足够的时间在比赛结束时对下一张地图进行投票。
Description_EN: If mp_endmatch_votenextmap is set, players have this much time to vote on the next map at match end.

Name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap_keepcurrent
Description: 若已设置，则将当前地图保留在投票选项列表中。
Description_EN: If set, keeps the current map in the list of voting options.

Name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap_wargames_modes
Description: 战争游戏期间可用于最终比赛投票的模式。
Description_EN: Modes available for endmatch voting during War Games.

Name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap_wargames_nummaps
Description: 战争游戏期间最终比赛投票中包含的最大地图数量
Description_EN: Maximum number of maps to include in endmatch voting during War Games

Name: mp_endmatch_votenextmap_wargames_nummodes
Description: 战争游戏期间最终比赛投票中包含的其他战争游戏的最大数量
Description_EN: Maximum number of other War Games to include in endmatch voting during War Games

Name: mp_endwarmup_player_count
Description: 提前结束热身所需连接的玩家数量。
Description_EN: Number of players required to be connected to end warmup early.

Name: mp_equipment_reset_rounds
Description: 每 N 轮重置所有玩家装备（0 代表从不）
Description_EN: Reset all player equipment every N rounds (0 for never)

Name: mp_footsteps_serverside
Description: 使服务器始终播放脚步声。
Description_EN: Makes the server always play footstep sounds.

Name: mp_force_pick_time
Description: 在自动组队之前，玩家在团队屏幕上进行选择的时间
Description_EN: The amount of time a player has on the team screen to make a selection before being auto-teamed

Name: mp_fraglimit
Description: 游戏本身列表中没有描述的设置。
Description_EN: Setting with no description in the game's own list.

Name: mp_global_damage_per_second
Description: 如果高于 0，则随着时间的推移对玩家造成非致命伤害。
Description_EN: If above 0, deal non-lethal damage to players over time.

Name: mp_guardian_bomb_plant_custom_x_mark_location
Description: X,y,z 在具有自定义炸弹工厂边界的守护任务中显示炸弹工厂的 X。
Description_EN: X,y,z to display an X for the bomb plant in guardian missions with custom bomb plant boundaries.

Name: mp_guardian_target_site
Description: 若已设置，为炸弹地点的索引，将导致仅在该地点附近创建随机生成。
Description_EN: If set to the index of a bombsite, will cause random spawns to be only created near that site.

Name: mp_halftime_pausematch
Description: 设置为 1 可在半场倒计时结束后暂停比赛。
Description_EN: Set to 1 to pause match after halftime countdown elapses.

Name: mp_hostages_max
Description: 生成的人质最大数量。
Description_EN: Maximum number of hostages to spawn.

Name: mp_hostages_rescuetime
Description: 如果 CT 到达人质，则回合时间会增加额外时间。
Description_EN: Additional time added to round time if a hostage is reached by a CT.

Name: mp_hostages_run_speed_modifier
Description: 默认值为 1.0，通过将其设置为 < 1.0 来减慢人质的速度。
Description_EN: Default is 1.0, slow down hostages by setting this to < 1.0.

Name: mp_hostages_spawn_farthest
Description: 启用后将持续强制最远的人质生成。
Description_EN: When enabled will consistently force the farthest hostages to spawn.

Name: mp_hostages_spawn_force_positions
Description: 逗号分隔的从零开始的索引列表，用于强制生成位置，例如
Description_EN: Comma separated list of zero based indices to force spawn positions, e.g.

Name: mp_hostages_spawn_force_positions_xyz
Description: 以逗号分隔的 xyz 位置列表以强制生成位置，例如
Description_EN: Comma separated list of xyz locations to force spawn positions, e.g.

Name: mp_hostages_spawn_same_every_round
Description: 0 = 每回合随机生成人质，1 = 整场比赛生成相同的人质。
Description_EN: 0 = spawn hostages randomly every round, 1 = same spawns for entire match.

Name: mp_hostages_takedamage
Description: 人质是否会受伤。
Description_EN: Whether or not hostages can be hurt.

Name: mp_logdetail_items
Description: 每当玩家获得或丢失物品时都会记录一行。
Description_EN: Logs a line any time a player acquires or loses an item.

Name: mp_match_end_changelevel
Description: 在比赛结束时，即使下一张地图相同，也执行更改级别
Description_EN: At the end of the match, perform a changelevel even if next map is the same

Name: mp_match_end_restart
Description: 比赛结束时，执行重新启动而不是加载新地图
Description_EN: At the end of the match, perform a restart instead of loading a new map

Name: mp_match_restart_delay
Description: 比赛重新开始之前的时间（以秒为单位）。
Description_EN: Time (in seconds) until a match restarts.

Name: mp_min_halftime_duration
Description: 即使球队介绍处于活动状态，中场休息持续的最短秒数
Description_EN: Minimum number of seconds that halftime lasts even if team intros are active

Name: mp_modify_timeouts
Description: mp_modify_timeouts <CT|T> <N>，例如 mp_modify ct -1
Description_EN: Mp_modify_timeouts <CT|T> <N>, e.g., mp_modify ct -1

Name: mp_only_cts_rescue_hostages
Description: 游戏本身列表中没有描述的设置。
Description_EN: Setting with no description in the game's own list.

Name: mp_overtime_halftime_pausetimer
Description: 若已设置，为 1，则在每半个加时赛之前将 mp_halftime_pausetimer 设置为 1。
Description_EN: If set to 1 will set mp_halftime_pausetimer to 1 before every half of overtime.

Name: mp_overtime_limit
Description: 启用加时赛后，只能进行一定数量的加时赛
Description_EN: When overtime is enabled, only so many overtimes can be played

Name: mp_playerid_delay
Description: 延迟在状态栏中显示信息的秒数
Description_EN: Number of seconds to delay showing information in the status bar

Name: mp_playerid_hold
Description: 状态栏在失去瞄准目标后继续保持显示玩家旧信息的持续时间（秒）。
Description_EN: Number of seconds to keep showing old information in the status bar

Name: mp_promoted_item_enabled
Description: 允许购买促销商品。
Description_EN: Allow the purchasing of the promoted item.

Name: mp_randomspawn_dist
Description: 如果使用 mp_randomspawn，则确定在选择此点时是否测试距离。
Description_EN: If using mp_randomspawn, determines whether to test distance when selecting this spot.

Name: mp_randomspawn_los
Description: 如果使用 mp_randomspawn，则确定是否在生成时测试视线。
Description_EN: If using mp_randomspawn, determines whether to test Line of Sight when spawning.

Name: mp_require_gun_use_to_acquire
Description: 枪是否必须使用来获取或默认是触摸拾取
Description_EN: Whether guns must be +used to acquire or default is touch-to-pickup

Name: mp_respawnwavetime_ct
Description: CT 重生波之间的时间。
Description_EN: Time between respawn waves for CTs.

Name: mp_respawnwavetime_t
Description: 恐怖分子重生波之间的时间。
Description_EN: Time between respawn waves for Terrorists.

Name: mp_retake_ct_count
Description: 重拍时的 CT 数量。
Description_EN: Number of CT's when playing retakes.

Name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_bonus_card
Description: CT 奖励卡可在包点回防 (Retake)时用于全买回合。
Description_EN: CT bonus card for full buy round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_bonus_card_availability
Description: CT 奖励卡可用性模式可用于玩炸弹现场重夺时的全买回合。
Description_EN: CT bonus card availability pattern for full buy round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_default_pistol_round
Description: 包点回防 (Retake)时默认手枪回合的 CT 装载。
Description_EN: CT Loadouts for default pistol round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_enemy_card
Description: 当玩炸弹地点重夺时，CT 敌人卡可用于全买回合。
Description_EN: CT enemy card for full buy round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_ct_loadout_upgraded_pistol_round
Description: 回防模式 (Retake) 下，CT 阵营在升级手枪局使用的武器装备配置。
Description_EN: CT Loadouts for upgraded pistol round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_max_consecutive_rounds_same_target_site
Description: 限制针对同一站点的连续轮数。
Description_EN: Limit the number of consecutive rounds targeting the same site.

Name: mp_retake_t_count
Description: 重拍时恐怖分子的数量。
Description_EN: Number of terrorists when playing retakes.

Name: mp_retake_t_loadout_bonus_card
Description: 当玩炸弹现场重夺时，T 奖励卡可用于全额购买回合。
Description_EN: T bonus card for full buy round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_t_loadout_bonus_card_availability
Description: 当玩炸弹现场重夺时，T 奖励卡可用模式可用于全额购买回合。
Description_EN: T bonus card availability pattern for full buy round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_t_loadout_default_pistol_round
Description: 进行炸弹点重夺时默认手枪回合的装载。
Description_EN: T Loadouts for default pistol round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_t_loadout_enemy_card
Description: 在包点回防 (Retake)时，T 敌方卡可用于全买回合。
Description_EN: T enemy card for full buy round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_retake_t_loadout_upgraded_pistol_round
Description: 回防模式 (Retake) 下，T 阵营在升级手枪局使用的武器装备配置。
Description_EN: T Loadouts for upgraded pistol round when playing bomb site retake.

Name: mp_shoot_dropped_grenades
Description: 掉落的手榴弹在射击时会爆炸。
Description_EN: Dropped grenades detonate when shot.

Name: mp_solid_enemies
Description: 敌人有多坚固：0 = 透明； 1 = 完全固态
Description_EN: How solid are enemies: 0 = transparent; 1 = fully solid

Name: mp_spawnprotectiontime
Description: 踢出在回合重新开始后这么多秒内进行团队击杀的玩家。
Description_EN: Kick players who team-kill within this many seconds of a round restart.

Name: mp_starting_losses
Description: 确定初始连续亏损是多少。
Description_EN: Determines what the initial loss streak is.

Name: mp_suicide_penalty
Description: 惩罚自杀球员
Description_EN: Punish players for suicides

Name: mp_t_default_melee
Description: T 生成时使用的默认近战武器
Description_EN: The default melee weapon that the Ts will spawn with

Name: mp_tagging_scale
Description: 被击中时玩家标记修饰符的标量。
Description_EN: Scalar for player tagging modifier when hit.

Name: mp_td_dmgtokick

Name: snd_steamaudio_active_hrtf
Description: 活跃 HRTF 指数。
Description_EN: Index of active HRTF.

Name: snd_steamaudio_ambisonics_correction_type
Description: 0：使用阶次截断的 Ambisonics HRTF，无需校正。 1：使用扩散场均衡来校正阶次截断的高保真度立体声响复制 HRTF。
Description_EN: 0: Use order-truncated Ambisonics HRTF without correction. 1: Use diffuse field equalization to correct order-truncated Ambisonics HRTFs.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_dimensions_probelookup_usealternate
Description: 使用备用探针查找算法根据探针点的 kd 树查询侦听器位置的维度。
Description_EN: Use alternate probe lookup algorithm to query dimensions for listener position based on kd-tree of probe points.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_air_absorption_coefficient
Description: 空气吸收系数用于烘焙咬合计算。
Description_EN: Air absorption coefficient sued for baked occlusion calculation.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_mode
Description: 0：仅距离比。 1：仅偏差（1/r）。 2：仅偏差（线性）。 3：模式0和模式1，4：模式0和模式2
Description_EN: 0: distance ratio only. 1: deviation only (1/r). 2: deviation only (linear). 3: Mode 0 and Mode 1, 4: Mode 0 and Mode 2

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_pathing_deviation_slope
Description: 调整遮挡程度与偏差角度的关系。
Description_EN: Adjust how much occlusion goes does with deviation angle.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_pathing_exponent
Description: 通过路径增量的指数缩放来调整路径能量的缩放比例。
Description_EN: Adjust scaling of pathing energy by exponentiall scaling with pathing delta.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_probelookup_usealternate
Description: 使用备用探针查找算法基于探针点的 kd 树来查询源和听者位置的遮挡。
Description_EN: Use alternate probe lookup algorithm to query occlusion for source and listener position based on kd-tree of probe points.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_reflection_factor
Description: 组合反射能量来计算遮挡值时调整反射能量的缩放比例。
Description_EN: Adjust scaling for reflection energy when combining it to calculate occlusion value.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_reflection_regularization
Description: 环境噪声能量充当反射能量的底线。
Description_EN: Ambient noise energy to serve as a floor for reflection energy.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_spatialfilter_mode
Description: 0：无空间过滤。 1：双向空间滤波器。
Description_EN: 0: No spatial filtering. 1: bidirectional spatial filter.

Name: snd_steamaudio_baked_occlusion_spatialfilter_radius_factor
Description: 半径系数，乘以探头之间的距离，以获得探头平均的半径。
Description_EN: Radius factor to multiply the distance between probes with to get the radius withing which probes are averaged.

Name: snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_outsidefield_bake_enabled
Description: 启用外部字段烘焙，以便探针烘焙自定义尺寸数据。
Description_EN: Enable baking outside field for probes baking custom dimensions data.

Name: snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_size_and_inout_bake_enabled
Description: 烘焙自定义尺寸数据时启用探针的烘焙尺寸和输入输出数据。
Description_EN: Enable baking size and inout data for probes when baking custom dimensions data.

Name: snd_steamaudio_custombake_dimensions_smallsizefield_bake_enabled
Description: 烘焙自定义尺寸数据时启用探针的烘焙 insize 尺寸字段。
Description_EN: Enable baking insize size field for probes when baking custom dimensions data.

Name: snd_steamaudio_custombake_occlusion_bidirectional
Description: 从源和监听器运行模拟并对结果进行平均。减少噪音的潜在方法。
Description_EN: Run simulation from both source and listner and average the results. Potential way to reduce noise.

Name: snd_steamaudio_custombake_occlusion_numsimulations
Description: 烘焙遮挡时运行的反射模拟的数量。减少噪音的潜在方法。
Description_EN: Number of reflection simulations to run when baking occlusion. Potential way to reduce noise.

Name: snd_steamaudio_debug_cover_navmesh_probe_size_scale
Description: 调试选项可生成缩放大小的集群探针以进行调试可视化。
Description_EN: Debug option to generate clustered probes of a scaled size for debug visualization.

Name: snd_steamaudio_default_hrtf_volume_gain
Description: 按指定增益 (dB) 调整默认 HRTF 的整体音量。
Description_EN: Adjust overall volume of the default HRTF by the specified gain (dB).

Name: snd_steamaudio_diagnostic_baked_occlusion_single_probe
Description: 使用给定的探针 ID 对单个源探针进行烘焙遮挡。
Description_EN: Bake occlusion for a single source probe with the given probe id.

Name: snd_steamaudio_dimensions_grid_height_max
Description: 我们允许在初始层上方添加探针的最大高度（距地面）。 （米）
Description_EN: The maximum height (from the ground) we allow probes to be added above the initial layer. (meters)

Name: snd_steamaudio_dimensions_grid_height_spacing
Description: 0 禁用 - 在高度间距（米）的网格间隔上方添加另一层探针

Description: 若设为 true，则主线程会在每个纹理释放周围暂停和取消暂停 Vulkan 工作线程，这允许工作线程取得一点进展，但会导致主线程停顿。如果为 false，我们将让工作线程暂停，直到所有解除分配完成，从而使解除分配的完成速度显着加快。
Description_EN: If true, the main thread pauses and unpauses the Vulkan worker threads around each texture deallocation, which allows the workers to make a little bit of progress but results in main thread stalls. If false, we keep the workers paused until all deallocations are done, allowing the deallocations to complete significantly faster.

-stream [1|0] 启动|终止到物理调试器的流式传输
-所有实体包括非物理实体
-classes 打印类名
-sdk Rubikon范围内存短缺状态
-sdk -struct 每个结构的 Rubikon 范围内的内存使用情况
-sdk -rebuildsvms Rubikon 范围的 SVM 强制重建和状态
- 世界现状
-world -touch 列出身体对（接触的身体）
-world -save <名称> 将世界保存到文件中

-world -agg 当前聚合数据注册表（加载的资源）

List all physics component contents of every entity in the game;
-stream [1|0]         initiate|terminate streaming to physics debugger
-allents              include non-physical entities
-classes              print class names
-sdk                  Rubikon-wide memory short status
-sdk -struct          Rubikon-wide memory use per struct
-sdk -rebuildsvms     Rubikon-wide SVM force rebuild and status
-world                current state of the world
-world -touch         list body pairs (bodies in contact)
-world -save <name>   save world to a file
